sector.narrative: Disaster preparedness frameworks and / or anticipatory action that build resilience
Enhancing child-sensitive social protection legal and policy frameworks
Field Monitoring, including third party monitoring and remote monitoring
Humanitarian planning and review activities (HRP, RRP, UNICEF HAC)
Procurment and optimizing supply chains through, but not limited to, capacity building, supply financing, localization, and digitalization
Risk assessment and analysis-(multi-hazard--e.g. CCRA, or natural hazards, environmental risk, and / or climate risk--e.g. CLAC)
SBC in emergencies programming, including preparedness and response for Public Health emergencies and Humanitarian action
Social protection and welfare services policy, planning and administration
Strengthening social protection delivery and administrative systems (MIS, registies, payment, grievance and redress, M&E)
Water sector policy and administrative management
